name: Wales (1953–1959)
description: Two horizontal stripes of white over green with the Royal Badge of Wales in the centre: a red dragon on a green mount within a garter bearing the motto 'Y Ddraig Goch Ddyry Cychwyn', surmounted by a crown.
history: The flag augmented with the Royal Badge of Wales in 1953, when the badge was granted, was used as the official flag of Wales from 11 March 1953. It was unpopular, and on 23 February 1959 the plain red dragon on white and green was recognised as the national flag.
